## Have you checked the Limitations section?

README's [Limitations](https://github.com/akakritagya/nepkit#limitations)
section lists known, deliberate boundaries (no time-of-day, no Nepali-language
formatting, the hard-bounded date range). If your request is one of these,
say so anyway — it's still useful to know which limitation is actually being
hit in practice.
